title: Calibrate anagram decoding with fewer anchors before trusting its acceptance score
statement: One-substitution emissions improve recovery on noisy anagrams given up to ten unknown mappings, but an unanchored 720-candidate search never recovers a complete key and the softer score accepts some French panels as Spanish.
check: Independently reproduce the anchored and unanchored controls from the attached design. Count active cipher symbols and report accuracy on covered symbols separately from the entire map. Before testing any manuscript claim, calibrate a threshold on held-apart target and matched-language negatives with larger independent document samples. Compare exact and softened emissions under matched budgets and an explicit search initializer, and retain a known-key oracle to separate search from word-emission errors.

frozen_conditions.question: Do one-substitution emissions improve true word and key recovery and maintain rejection of unrelated text as the number of unknown symbol assignments grows?
frozen_conditions.comparison: Reproduce the bounded shape of PR 264 at four unknown letters and use fixed nested anchor masks to extend it. This is unigram conditional-on-length bag scoring, without Hauer and Kondrak's sequential model.
frozen_conditions.reference_protocol: Use project train_text solely for dictionary, all-word length denominators and add-one character frequencies. Take source documents only from the reference control split. These are publication-corpus controls, with no manuscript data. Frozen offsets start beyond the earlier submission's first 20 windows.

panels.description: Unrelated source blocks from the same declared target language, using fixed held-apart token offsets.
Draw French control tokens with replacement by length to reproduce each positive document's exact length sequence.

Permute the complete letter inventory of each positive document across all positions and retile at its original word lengths. Each negative has the exact letter inventory and word-length sequence of its positive. Within-token permutation alone is an invariance of bag models and is not a negative here.

tiers.search: bounded transposition search with paired restarts
bounded transposition search with paired restarts

noise.description: Uniformly shuffle positions inside each word, draw a fixed substitution uniform and a replacement among the other 25 letters per position, then apply a full uniform substitution key. Nest the applied noise across rates. Use identical ciphertext, true map anchors, source splits and candidate-count ceilings for the two emissions.

frozen_conditions.acceptance: Use mean held-apart log likelihood ratio strictly greater than zero, with the same threshold as PR 264. Do not tune a threshold.
primary_metrics: Fraction of evaluation words whose most likely lexical word matches the original on true target panels
All unknown assignments recovered, and proportion of unknown mappings recovered
Accepted target panels and accepted negative panels by kind
Documentwise paired differences and 95% Wilson intervals for absolute document acceptance rates
frozen_conditions.caveats: Known letters in partial tiers are supplied, not inferred. More unknown letters at the same evaluation budget changes coverage, search and inference jointly. Cipher keys and noise are synthetic. Repeated source panels across methods, noise rates, and tiers are paired and not independent observations.

evidence.objective: Rank keys by training-half mean log of 0.95 times the conditional lexical mass divided by the independent-letter bag probability, plus 0.05. The soft emission marginalizes exact and one-substitution multiplicities over source positions. At 10 and 26 unknowns the paired six restarts score 120 distinct candidates each. Per step choose the first unvisited random-order swap from the current assignment, moving on ties or improvements. If there are no unvisited local swaps, fill from the deterministic anchored permutations. The methods use identical starts and swap-order draws, while accepted moves can differ.
primary_findings: For 4, 6 and 10 unknown assignments, both scorers recovered every unknown map on the true positive panels at all four tested noise rates. At ten unknowns and 2% noise, soft emissions raised exact word recovery from 399 to 417 of 512 in English and from 423 to 443 of 512 in Spanish. At 10% noise the counts rose from 272 to 354 and from 310 to 384 respectively.

At 26 unknowns, neither method recovered a full key in any positive panel at any noise rate. In Spanish at 2% noise, soft acceptance increased from 0 to 4 of 8 target panels despite only 34 of 512 words recovered and 2.375 of 26 ordinary letter assignments recovered on average.

In the unanchored Spanish runs, the softer score also accepted 2/8 unrelated French panels at zero noise, 1/8 at 2%, 0/8 at 5%, and 1/8 at 10%. Those positive decisions cover three distinct French panels, with reuse across the noise levels. The exact score accepted none. No letter-retiled negative passed in any condition. No French panel passed for either model in the anchored runs or the English runs.

The zero cutoff is inherited from the earlier pilot. Truncating the dictionary to 5,000 types while using all length-channel tokens for the denominator, plus dropping two-or-more simultaneous substitutions, makes the lexical model retained mass smaller than one. The score is a comparable decision rule here, not a normalized likelihood ratio. Acceptance and correct decoding are distinct endpoints.

planted_key_and_symbol_coverage_diagnost.purpose: Supplementary known-key lexical ceiling and alphabet exposure. No key search was run.
planted_key_and_symbol_coverage_diagnost.method: Use eligible project training and control words via the frozen runner. For each positive window build ciphertext using cipher_at_all_noise_levels, translate only its evaluation half with the planted decode map, and evaluate best_word and the legacy score. Count absent unknown mappings on the clean fitting half by underlying plaintext symbol.

windows.tier_rule: All tiers use the same first eight windows for this auxiliary comparison.
